Stop with exact unresolved dependencies if full admission exceeds the session; do not launch a new lowering census on an unvalidated premise or substitute extra root digits for mechanism checking.

actual_scope: Exact sharp minimum of two pooled fixed-T16 integer profiles for every real 0<=a<=1/2; maximal initial optimality interval of predecessor profile via unique phase transition.
scope_change_reason: PR3364 explicitly leaves actual maximal integer-profile optimality open. A minimum of 49 path candidates removes its fixed-potential failure and proves a genuine optimizer change. This is a mathematical inventory theorem, not a new physical lowering census.
bottleneck_link: Separates a source-bound integer packing theorem from physical attainment and gives exact uniform constraints on unchanged T16 inventories.
stop_rule: Stop after continuum lower-bound proof, two exact attaining inventories, unique transition argument, source checks and semantic controls; no physical supplier or numerical kappa search.
evidence: README.md full proof, CERTIFICATE.json two attainable profiles and 49 path candidates, RESULT.json complete exact receipt.
